page: Microsoft Azure EC20ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ECADSv5 family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 20 dedicated vCPUs paired with 160.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

For local storage needs, the EC20ads_v5 includes a bundled 768 GB local SSD. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach high-performance external storage volumes. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, the EC20ads_v5 provides a resource-dense profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads. The inclusion of local SSD storage and Premium Storage compatibility makes it highly applicable for database hosting, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks where local caching is beneficial.
